name: Pipeline Segment - Electron GN Check

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      target-platform:
        type: string
        description: 'Platform to run on, can be macos, win or linux'
        required: true
      target-archs:
        type: string
        description: 'Archs to check for, can be x64 or arm64 space separated'
        required: true
      check-runs-on:
        type: string
        description: 'What host to run the tests on'
        required: true
      check-container:
        type: string
        description: 'JSON container information for aks runs-on'
        required: false
        default: '{"image":null}'
    secrets:
      ELECTRON_RBE_JWT:
        required: false

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: electron-gn-check-${{ inputs.target-platform }}-${{ github.ref_protected == true && github.run_id || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref_protected != true }}

env:
  ELECTRON_RBE_JWT: ${{ secrets.ELECTRON_RBE_JWT }}
  GCLIENT_EXTRA_ARGS: ${{ inputs.target-platform == 'macos' && '--custom-var=checkout_mac=True --custom-var=host_os=mac --custom-var=host_cpu=arm64' || (inputs.target-platform == 'linux' && '--custom-var=checkout_arm64=True' || '--custom-var=checkout_win=True') }}
  ELECTRON_OUT_DIR: Default

jobs:
  gn-check:
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    runs-on: ${{ inputs.check-runs-on }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
    container: ${{ fromJSON(inputs.check-container) }} # zizmor: ignore[unpinned-images] the caller passes ghcr.io/electron/build tagged by the content hash computed in build.yml; there is no static digest to pin
    steps:
    - name: Use Cloudflare DNS (macOS)
      if: ${{ inputs.target-platform == 'macos' }}
      run: |
        sudo networksetup -setdnsservers Ethernet 1.1.1.1 1.0.0.1
        sudo dscacheutil -flushcache
        sudo killall -HUP mDNSResponder
    - name: Checkout Electron
      uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      with:
        path: src/electron
        fetch-depth: 0
        ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        persist-credentials: false
    - name: Cleanup disk space on macOS
      if: ${{ inputs.target-platform == 'macos' }}
      shell: bash
      run: |   
        sudo mkdir -p $TMPDIR/del-target

        tmpify() {
          if [ -d "$1" ]; then
            sudo mv "$1" $TMPDIR/del-target/$(echo $1|shasum -a 256|head -n1|cut -d " " -f1)
          fi
        }   
        tmpify /Library/Developer/CoreSimulator
        tmpify ~/Library/Developer/CoreSimulator
        sudo rm -rf $TMPDIR/del-target
    - name: Check disk space after freeing up space
      if: ${{ inputs.target-platform == 'macos' }}
      run: df -h
    - name: Set Chromium Git Cookie
      uses: ./src/electron/.github/actions/set-chromium-cookie
    - name: Install Build Tools
      uses: ./src/electron/.github/actions/install-build-tools
    - name: Enable windows toolchain
      if: ${{ inputs.target-platform == 'win' }}
      run: |
        echo "ELECTRON_DEPOT_TOOLS_WIN_TOOLCHAIN=1" >> $GITHUB_ENV
    - name: Generate DEPS Hash
      run: |
        node src/electron/script/generate-deps-hash.js
        DEPSHASH=v2-src-cache-$(cat src/electron/.depshash)
        echo "DEPSHASH=$DEPSHASH" >> $GITHUB_ENV
        echo "CACHE_PATH=$DEPSHASH.tar" >> $GITHUB_ENV
    - name: Restore src cache via AZCopy
      if: ${{ inputs.target-platform == 'macos' }}
      uses: ./src/electron/.github/actions/restore-cache-azcopy
      with:
        target-platform: ${{ inputs.target-platform }}      
    - name: Restore src cache via AKS
      if: ${{ inputs.target-platform == 'linux' || inputs.target-platform == 'win' }}
      uses: ./src/electron/.github/actions/restore-cache-aks
      with:
        target-platform: ${{ inputs.target-platform }}
    - name: Checkout Electron
      uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      with:
        path: src/electron
        fetch-depth: 0
        ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        persist-credentials: false
    - name: Fix hermetic Python (macOS)
      if: ${{ inputs.target-platform == 'macos' }}
      uses: ./src/electron/.github/actions/cipd-install
      with:
        dependency: cpython3-host
        deps-file: src/DEPS
        installation-dir: src/third_party/cpython3/host
        target-platform: ${{ inputs.target-platform }}
        package: infra/3pp/tools/cpython3/${platform}
    - name: Run Electron Only Hooks
      env:
        TARGET_PLATFORM: ${{ inputs.target-platform }}
      run: |
        echo "solutions=[{'name':'src/electron','url':None,'deps_file':'DEPS','custom_vars':{'process_deps':False},'managed':False}]" > tmpgclient
        if [ "$TARGET_PLATFORM" = "win" ]; then
          echo "solutions=[{'name':'src/electron','url':None,'deps_file':'DEPS','custom_vars':{'process_deps':False,'install_sysroot':False,'checkout_win':True},'managed':False}]" > tmpgclient
          echo "target_os=['win']" >> tmpgclient
        fi
        e d gclient runhooks --gclientfile=tmpgclient

        # Fix VS Toolchain
        if [ "$TARGET_PLATFORM" = "win" ]; then
          rm -rf src/third_party/depot_tools/win_toolchain/vs_files
          e d python3 src/build/vs_toolchain.py update --force
        fi
    - name: Regenerate DEPS Hash
      run: |
        (cd src/electron && git checkout .) && node src/electron/script/generate-deps-hash.js
        echo "DEPSHASH=$(cat src/electron/.depshash)" >> $GITHUB_ENV
    - name: Install Dependencies
      uses: ./src/electron/.github/actions/install-dependencies
    - name: Default GN gen
      run: |
        cd src/electron
        git pack-refs
    # The testing config sets is_official_build = false, so a check against
    # only the testing args never evaluates targets that are only reachable
    # with official-build flags and release-only graph breakage surfaces for
    # the first time in publish builds. Run gn gen + check (no compile) with
    # the release args as well to catch that here. No PGO profile download is
    # needed: gn gen only read_file()s the checked-in state files in
    # build/pgo_profiles, the profiles themselves are compile-time inputs.
    - name: Run GN Check for ${{ inputs.target-archs }}
      env:
        TARGET_PLATFORM: ${{ inputs.target-platform }}
        TARGET_ARCHS: ${{ inputs.target-archs }}
      run: |
        for build_type in testing release
        do
          for target_cpu in $TARGET_ARCHS
          do
            e init -f --root=$(pwd) --out=Default $build_type --import $build_type --target-cpu $target_cpu --remote-build none
            cd src/electron
            export GN_EXTRA_ARGS="target_cpu=\"$target_cpu\""
            if [ "$TARGET_PLATFORM" = "linux" ]; then
              if [ "$target_cpu" = "arm64" ]; then
                export GN_EXTRA_ARGS="$GN_EXTRA_ARGS fatal_linker_warnings=false enable_linux_installer=false"
              fi
            fi
            if [ "$TARGET_PLATFORM" = "win" ]; then
              export GN_EXTRA_ARGS="$GN_EXTRA_ARGS use_v8_context_snapshot=true target_os=\"win\""
            fi

            e build --gen=only

            npm run gn-check -- --outDir Default

            # The publish matrix also builds a Mac App Store variant of every
            # macOS release, so check that graph too.
            if [ "$TARGET_PLATFORM" = "macos" ] && [ "$build_type" = "release" ]; then
              export GN_EXTRA_ARGS="$GN_EXTRA_ARGS is_mas_build=true"

              e build --gen=only

              npm run gn-check -- --outDir Default
            fi
            cd ../..
          done
        done

        # These checks do not depend on the gn config, so run them once.
        cd src/electron

        # Check the hunspell filenames
        node script/gen-hunspell-filenames.js --check

        node script/gen-libc++-filenames.js --check
        node script/gen-siso-revision.js --check
        node script/gen-filenames.mts --check
    - name: Wait for active SSH sessions
      if: always() && !cancelled()
      shell: bash
      run: |
        while [ -f /var/.ssh-lock ]
        do
          sleep 60
        done

name: Pipeline Segment - Build Siso

# Builds a patched siso binary for a single CI build host. Reads the siso
# revision from build/siso_revision (kept in step with Chromium's DEPS by the
# gen_siso_revision gclient hook and checked in gn-check; nothing is fetched
# here), shallow-clones chromium.googlesource.com/build at that revision, applies the
# patches under .github/siso-patches/, and cross-compiles siso for the requested
# build host. siso runs on the build host (not the target), so three host arches
# cover every build job: Windows targets use windows-amd64, Linux targets (any
# arch) use linux-amd64, and macOS targets (x64 or arm64) use darwin-arm64
# because the macOS build hosts are arm64. Each caller invokes this segment once
# per host it needs, so a cache miss (or manual re-run) for one host only affects
# that host's builds rather than every platform. The binary is published as the
# artifact siso-<host> that the build and publish jobs download and use via
# SISO_PATH, and is cached keyed on the siso revision + sha256 of the patch
# contents, so subsequent runs just restore it.

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      host:
        description: >-
          Build host to compile siso for: windows-amd64, linux-amd64 or
          darwin-arm64.
        required: true
        type: string

permissions: {}

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
    - name: Resolve host build parameters
      id: host
      env:
        HOST: ${{ inputs.host }}
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        case "$HOST" in
          windows-amd64) goos=windows; goarch=amd64; binary=siso.exe ;;
          linux-amd64)   goos=linux;   goarch=amd64; binary=siso ;;
          darwin-arm64)  goos=darwin;  goarch=arm64; binary=siso ;;
          *) echo "error: unsupported host: $HOST" >&2; exit 1 ;;
        esac
        {
          echo "goos=${goos}"
          echo "goarch=${goarch}"
          echo "binary=${binary}"
        } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
    - name: Checkout Electron
      uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      with:
        fetch-depth: 1
        ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        sparse-checkout: |
          build/siso_revision
          .github/siso-patches
        persist-credentials: false
    - name: Resolve siso revision
      id: resolve
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        SISO_SHA=$(tr -d '[:space:]' < build/siso_revision)
        if ! [[ "$SISO_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
          echo "error: build/siso_revision does not hold a 40-char git SHA: '$SISO_SHA'" >&2
          exit 1
        fi
        PATCHES_HASH=$(find .github/siso-patches -type f -name '*.patch' | sort | xargs sha256sum | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
        echo "siso-sha=${SISO_SHA}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
        echo "patches-hash=${PATCHES_HASH}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
        echo "build/siso_revision pins siso at ${SISO_SHA}"
        echo "Patches hash: ${PATCHES_HASH}"
    - name: Restore cached siso binary
      id: cache-siso
      uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
      with:
        path: siso-out/${{ steps.host.outputs.binary }}
        key: siso-${{ inputs.host }}-${{ steps.resolve.outputs.siso-sha }}-${{ steps.resolve.outputs.patches-hash }}
    - name: Shallow clone chromium build repo at pinned revision
      if: steps.cache-siso.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
      env:
        SISO_SHA: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.siso-sha }}
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        mkdir chromium-build
        cd chromium-build
        git init -q
        git remote add origin https://chromium.googlesource.com/build
        git -c protocol.version=2 fetch --depth=1 origin "$SISO_SHA"
        git checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD
    - name: Apply in-tree siso patches
      if: steps.cache-siso.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        shopt -s nullglob
        patches=("${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/.github/siso-patches"/*.patch)
        if [ ${#patches[@]} -eq 0 ]; then
          echo "No siso patches to apply"
          exit 0
        fi
        cd chromium-build
        git -c user.name=electron-ci -c user.email=ci@electronjs.org \
          am --3way "${patches[@]}"
    - name: Set up Go
      if: steps.cache-siso.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
      uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
      with:
        go-version-file: chromium-build/siso/go.mod
        cache: false
    - name: Test patched siso spawn-helper packages
      if: steps.cache-siso.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
      working-directory: chromium-build/siso
      # Runs natively on the workflow host (no GOOS/GOARCH): `go build` alone
      # never compiles or runs _test.go files, so without this the tests the
      # in-tree patches add would not gate the build. localexec is included
      # because it drives the spawn helper end-to-end.
      run: |
        go test ./execute/spawnhelper/ ./execute/localexec/
    - name: Build siso (${{ inputs.host }})
      if: steps.cache-siso.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
      working-directory: chromium-build/siso
      env:
        CGO_ENABLED: '0'
        GOOS: ${{ steps.host.outputs.goos }}
        GOARCH: ${{ steps.host.outputs.goarch }}
        BINARY: ${{ steps.host.outputs.binary }}
      run: |
        mkdir -p "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/siso-out"
        go build -trimpath -o "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/siso-out/${BINARY}" .
    - name: Upload siso artifact
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
      with:
        name: siso-${{ inputs.host }}
        path: siso-out/${{ steps.host.outputs.binary }}
        if-no-files-found: error
        retention-days: 5

name: Electron Lint

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      container:
        required: true
        description: 'Container to run lint in'
        type: string
      skip:
        required: false
        description: 'Skip the actual lint work but still report the lint / Lint check as skipped'
        type: boolean
        default: false
    secrets:
      CHROMIUM_GIT_COOKIE:
        required: false

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: electron-lint-${{ github.ref_protected == true && github.run_id || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref_protected != true }}

env:
  CHROMIUM_GIT_COOKIE: ${{ secrets.CHROMIUM_GIT_COOKIE }}  

jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint
    if: ${{ !inputs.skip }}
    runs-on: electron-arc-centralus-linux-amd64-4core
    permissions:
      contents: read
    timeout-minutes: 20
    container: ${{ fromJSON(inputs.container) }} # zizmor: ignore[unpinned-images] the caller passes ghcr.io/electron/build tagged by the content hash computed in build.yml; there is no static digest to pin
    steps:
    - name: Checkout Electron
      uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      with:
        path: src/electron
        fetch-depth: 0
        ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        persist-credentials: false
    - name: Install Dependencies
      uses: ./src/electron/.github/actions/install-dependencies
    - name: Set Chromium Git Cookie
      uses: ./src/electron/.github/actions/set-chromium-cookie
    - name: Install Build Tools
      uses: ./src/electron/.github/actions/install-build-tools
    - name: Get Chromium revision
      id: get-chromium-revision
      shell: bash
      run: |
        chromium_revision=$(e depot-tools gclient getdep --deps-file=src/electron/DEPS --revision=src | tail -1)
        if [[ ! "$chromium_revision" =~ ^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+$ ]]; then
          echo "::error::Invalid chromium_revision: $chromium_revision"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "revision=$chromium_revision" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
    # Chromium's DEPS and buildtools/DEPS only change on a Chromium roll, so
    # keep a copy per revision on the cross-instance cache share (where the src
    # cache lives) instead of hitting the shared API limit every run.
    #
    # The cached copy may have been written by any PR's workflow, so treat it as
    # untrusted: it can only pick which genuine Google-built gn and
    # clang-format get downloaded, and only after the strict checks in
    # read_lint_deps, which the steps below take their values from.
    - name: Get Chromium DEPS
      id: get-chromium-deps
      shell: bash
      env:
        chromium_revision: ${{ steps.get-chromium-revision.outputs.revision }}
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      run: |
        cache_dir=/mnt/cross-instance-cache/lint-chromium-deps
        cached_deps=$cache_dir/$chromium_revision.DEPS
        cached_buildtools_deps=$cache_dir/$chromium_revision.buildtools-DEPS

        fetch_chromium_file() {
          local path=$1 out=$2
          if curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 15 --retry-max-time 90 \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer ${GITHUB_TOKEN}" \
            -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw+json" \
            -H "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28" \
            -o "$out" "https://api.github.com/repos/chromium/chromium/contents/${path}?ref=refs/tags/${chromium_revision}"; then
            return 0
          fi
          echo "::warning::GitHub contents API fetch of ${path} failed, falling back to chromium.googlesource.com"
          local cookie_args=()
          if [[ -f ~/.gitcookies ]]; then
            cookie_args=(-b ~/.gitcookies)
          fi
          curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 15 "${cookie_args[@]}" \
            "https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/${chromium_revision}/${path}?format=TEXT" | base64 -d > "$out"
        }

        # Prints "<gn_version> <clang-format object_name> <sha256sum>" read from
        # DEPS ($1) and buildtools/DEPS ($2), or fails if anything lint needs is
        # missing or malformed, so a bad copy is never used or cached.
        read_lint_deps() {
          local gn_version clang_format_objects
          gn_version=$(e depot-tools gclient getdep --deps-file="$1" --var=gn_version | tail -1) || return 1
          if [[ ! "$gn_version" =~ ^git_revision:[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
            echo "Invalid gn_version in $1: $gn_version" >&2
            return 1
          fi
          clang_format_objects=$(e depot-tools gclient getdep --deps-file="$2" --revision=linux64-format | tail -1) || return 1
          python3 -I -c '
        import ast, re, sys
        try:
            objects = ast.literal_eval(sys.argv[2])
        except (ValueError, SyntaxError):
            sys.exit("linux64-format in buildtools/DEPS is not a GCS dependency")
        if not (isinstance(objects, list) and len(objects) == 1 and isinstance(objects[0], dict)):
            sys.exit("linux64-format in buildtools/DEPS must have exactly one object")
        name, sha256 = objects[0].get("object_name"), objects[0].get("sha256sum")
        if not (isinstance(name, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", name)):
            sys.exit(f"Invalid clang-format object_name: {name!r}")
        if not (isinstance(sha256, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", sha256)):
            sys.exit(f"Invalid clang-format sha256sum: {sha256!r}")
        print(sys.argv[1], name, sha256)
        ' "$gn_version" "$clang_format_objects"
        }

        save_to_cache() {
          if [ ! -d /mnt/cross-instance-cache ]; then
            echo "Cross-instance cache is not mounted, not saving Chromium DEPS"
            return
          fi
          # Copy to run-unique temp names first so concurrent readers never see
          # a partially-written file. Failing to save shouldn't fail lint.
          local upload_suffix=upload-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}
          if mkdir -p "$cache_dir" \
            && cp src/DEPS "$cached_deps.$upload_suffix" \
            && cp src/buildtools/DEPS "$cached_buildtools_deps.$upload_suffix" \
            && mv -f "$cached_buildtools_deps.$upload_suffix" "$cached_buildtools_deps" \
            && mv -f "$cached_deps.$upload_suffix" "$cached_deps"; then
            echo "Saved Chromium DEPS for ${chromium_revision} to $cache_dir"
          else
            echo "::warning::Could not save Chromium DEPS for ${chromium_revision} to $cache_dir"
            rm -f "$cached_deps.$upload_suffix" "$cached_buildtools_deps.$upload_suffix"
          fi
        }

        mkdir -p src/buildtools
        if [ -s "$cached_deps" ] && [ -s "$cached_buildtools_deps" ] \
          && lint_deps=$(read_lint_deps "$cached_deps" "$cached_buildtools_deps"); then
          echo "Using cached Chromium DEPS for ${chromium_revision} from $cache_dir"
          cp "$cached_deps" src/DEPS
          cp "$cached_buildtools_deps" src/buildtools/DEPS
        else
          if [ -e "$cached_deps" ] || [ -e "$cached_buildtools_deps" ]; then
            echo "::warning::Cached Chromium DEPS for ${chromium_revision} are invalid, fetching and overwriting them"
          else
            echo "Chromium DEPS for ${chromium_revision} not cached, fetching"
          fi
          fetch_chromium_file DEPS src/DEPS
          fetch_chromium_file buildtools/DEPS src/buildtools/DEPS
          if ! lint_deps=$(read_lint_deps src/DEPS src/buildtools/DEPS); then
            echo "::error::Fetched DEPS files for ${chromium_revision} are not valid Chromium DEPS and buildtools/DEPS"
            exit 1
          fi
          save_to_cache
        fi

        read -r gn_version clang_format_object clang_format_sha256 <<< "$lint_deps"
        {
          echo "gn_version=$gn_version"
          echo "clang_format_object=$clang_format_object"
          echo "clang_format_sha256=$clang_format_sha256"
        } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
    - name: Download GN Binary
      shell: bash
      env:
        gn_version: ${{ steps.get-chromium-deps.outputs.gn_version }}
      run: |
        e d cipd ensure -ensure-file - -root . <<-CIPD
        \$ServiceURL https://chrome-infra-packages.appspot.com/
        @Subdir src/buildtools/linux64
        gn/gn/linux-amd64 $gn_version
        CIPD
    - name: Download clang-format Binary
      shell: bash
      env:
        object_name: ${{ steps.get-chromium-deps.outputs.clang_format_object }}
        sha256sum: ${{ steps.get-chromium-deps.outputs.clang_format_sha256 }}
      run: |
        # Don't gclient sync the possibly-cached buildtools/DEPS. Fetch only the
        # Linux clang-format object from Chromium's bucket and check its SHA-1
        # matches the name (the bucket is content-addressed).
        clang_format_dir=src/buildtools/linux64-format
        mkdir -p "$clang_format_dir"
        curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 15 -o "$clang_format_dir/clang-format.download" \
          "https://storage.googleapis.com/chromium-clang-format/${object_name}"
        if ! echo "${object_name}  $clang_format_dir/clang-format.download" | sha1sum --check --status \
          || ! echo "${sha256sum}  $clang_format_dir/clang-format.download" | sha256sum --check --status; then
          echo "::error::Downloaded clang-format ${object_name} does not match its expected hashes"
          rm -f "$clang_format_dir/clang-format.download"
          exit 1
        fi
        chmod +x "$clang_format_dir/clang-format.download"
        mv -f "$clang_format_dir/clang-format.download" "$clang_format_dir/clang-format"
    - name: Add problem matchers
      shell: bash
      run: |
        echo "::add-matcher::src/electron/.github/problem-matchers/markdownlint.json"
    - name: Run Lint
      shell: bash
      run: |
        # gn.py tries to find a gclient root folder starting from the current dir.
        # When it fails and returns "None" path, the whole script fails. Let's "fix" it.
        touch .gclient

        # Clean things up so `depot_tools/gclient_paths.py` finds src/buildtools properly
        rm -f .gclient_entries

        cd src/electron
        node script/yarn.js install --immutable
        node script/yarn.js lint
    - name: Run V8 Fingerprint Tests
      shell: bash
      run: |
        cd src/electron
        python3 script/v8-patch-fingerprint-test.py
    - name: Run Script Typechecker
      shell: bash
      run: |
        cd src/electron
        node script/yarn.js tsc -p tsconfig.script.json
    - name: Run Spec Typechecker
      shell: bash
      run: |
        # Relies on the electron.d.ts that `lint:docs` generated in Run Lint.
        cd src/electron
        node script/yarn.js tsc -p tsconfig.spec.json
    - name: Check GHA Workflows
      shell: bash
      run: |
        cd src/electron
        node script/copy-pipeline-segment-publish.js --check
